units.text: I cannot check the status of your school's submission or access your personal application records.
units.reason: This is a pure assertion of the assistant's access limits, not a business fact.

units.text: To verify whether a correction was processed, log in to fafsa.gov with your FSA ID and check the status of your FAFSA form; it will show 'Processed Successfully' if no further action is needed.
supporting_chunk_ids: How to Review and Correct Your FAFSA® Application | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states that after submitting, you can check status at fafsa.gov with FSA ID, and 'Processed Successfully' means no further action needed.

units.text: If you see 'Action Required' or have concerns about how your school handled the correction, contact your school's financial aid office directly.
supporting_chunk_ids: How to Review and Correct Your FAFSA® Application | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context says 'Action Required' means contact your school to resolve the issue, and the school's financial aid office is the appropriate contact.

units.text: If you believe the school violated federal regulations and you've tried to resolve it with them unsuccessfully, you can contact the Federal Student Aid Feedback Center at 1-844-651-0077.
